about_the_game:
Do you love cats? How about a bit of chaos, strategy, and cuteness all mixed together?

Then welcome to Istanbul's purr-fect neighborhood. Run your own little cat business in the heart of where East meets West, team up with uniquely talented Turkish feline friends, grow your production — and make some lira along the way. It may look adorable on the surface… but beneath it lies a system that rewards smart decisions.

Key Features

✔ Historic Istanbul Setting – Build your cat empire across neighborhoods inspired by iconic Istanbul locations, from the Grand Bazaar to the Bosphorus waterfront. Meet legendary Turkish cat breeds in their natural habitat.

✔ Limited Space, Endless Possibilities – Make the most of Istanbul's narrow streets and compact shops. Every tile matters in this bustling metropolis.

✔ Cycle-Breaking Spirits – Special spirits inspired by Turkish folklore can turn the tide of a match — but triggering them takes skill.

✔ Turkish Cat Collection – Collect dozens of cats including the swimming Turkish Van, and the beloved street cats that rule Istanbul's alleys, each with unique passive abilities.

✔ Bazaar Shops, Turkish Treats & More – Personalize your system with special items like simit stands, fish markets, and tea houses that boost your production.

✔ Lira & Rent System – Optimize your income and don't forget to pay your rent... or you'll be sleeping with the street cats under the Galata Bridge!

✔ Synergy & Interaction – The way your cats interact can make or break your economy — just like the real cat colonies of Istanbul.

A bit of Turkish tea, a bit of organized chaos — and a whole neighborhood of fur-covered economy.

In this Istanbul neighborhood, everyone finds their own way. Are you ready to find yours?

Don't miss the cutest corner of Istanbul. Add it to your wishlist!

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750

It may look adorable... but underneath lies a game that rewards careful planning, just like navigating the Grand Bazaar itself.
